name: Khronon-Slip P7-Isolator: Bimetric with Kinetic-Isolated Hořava Chassis and Nonlocal F+ MOND
claimed_mechanism: This bimetric architecture exits the single-metric DC-013 slip-lock by introducing a genuine second dynamical metric (f_mu_nu) for matter coupling, thereby breaking the diffeomorphism invariance lock that previously forced frameless lensing to fail. The MOND force law is carried by a spatially nonlocal F+ kernel acting on the physical metric (g_mu_nu), completely decoupling the momentum scaling of the MOND sector from the PPN amplitude. A Hořava-like foliation field (u_mu) with strictly degenerate kinetic terms mediates the off-ray lensing slip (Psi=Phi) and PPN preferred-frame response, with the coupling explicitly screened by e^-y.
predicted_weak_field: In the weak-field limit, the massive graviton generated by the Hassan-Rosen interaction is decoupled from the MOND sector, preserving c_T=1 for the physical metric. The MOND force law is recovered exactly via the nonlocal F+ kernel, which acts at galactic scales (k < a0/c^2) while the massive graviton screens at solar system scales. The lensing response is off-ray (Psi=Phi) due to the u_mu slip, while the PPN alpha parameters are suppressed by e^-y, decoupling the screened response from the kinetic normalization of the u_mu field.
inequivalence_argument: This is genuinely inequivalent to DC-001, DC-012, and DC-013 because it abandons the single-metric assumption, which is the core premise of the 108k exhaustive search and the slip-lock theorem. The bimetric structure introduces a genuine off-ray lensing carrier via the massive graviton/metric slip, which is impossible in the frameless single-metric class. It is inequivalent to DC-010 (khronometric) because the u_mu field has degenerate kinetic terms and is not a propagating khronon, thereby avoiding the P7 strong-coupling wall that kills the khronometric candidate when alpha->0. It is inequivalent to DC-011/DC-012 (localization) because the F+ kernel is genuinely nonlocal and not localized, avoiding the empty-window and under-lensing kills.
